about: The standard frame-rate benchmark: the Glacier world (survival on the any-map start, no cold storm; the penal colony and its spots went 2026-11-17, so a baseline from before then is not comparable). Each spot's view is the window tool's 'view TARGET | DIST,UP,BEARING' (Program.WindowShotTour.cs). Keep the names stable: --bench-compare matches spots by name. docs/perf/BENCHMARK.md
